{{Current events|year=2023|month=03|day=10|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man is shot dead by an [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settler]] near a farm in [[Karnei Shomron]], in the [[West Bank]]. The [[Israeli military]] claims that the man was armed at the time. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/10/israeli-settler-kills-palestinian-in-occupied-west-bank (Al Jazeera)] 

'''Business and economy'''
*American [[commercial bank]] [[Silicon Valley Bank]] is forcibly shut down by regulators for the [[U.S. state]] of [[California]], and its assets taken control by the [[Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation]], after it failed to raise enough [[financial capital|capital]] and a subsequent [[bank run]] occurred. With assets totalling [[United States dollar|US$]]209 billion, its closure is the [[List of largest U.S. bank failures|second-largest bank failure in American history]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/03/10/investing/svb-bank/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/silicon-valley-bank-collapses-fdic-b2298381.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**[[Iran]] and [[Saudi Arabia]] agree to resume [[diplomatic relations]] and reopen their [[embassies]] within the next two months, in a joint statement brokered by the [[Government of China|Chinese government]], after diplomatic talks in [[Beijing]], [[China]].[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/10/iran-and-saudi-agree-to-restore-relations (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Malaysia]]
**Former [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|Malaysian Prime Minister]] [[Muhyiddin Yassin]] is [[criminal charge|charged]] with corruption and [[abuse of power]] by the [[Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission]] (MACC) over a COVID-19 subsidy programme. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-muhyiddin-yassin-macc-arrest-corruption-money-laundering-3336946 (CNA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 People's Republic of China presidential election]]
**[[Xi Jinping]] is re-elected to an unprecedented third term as [[President of the People's Republic of China|president]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/mar/10/xi-jinping-handed-unprecedented-third-term-as-chinas-president (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Prince Edward, Duke of Edinburgh|Prince Edward]] is named as the new [[Duke of Edinburgh]] by [[King Charles III]], the title previously held by their father, [[Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh|Prince Philip]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-64913224 (''BBC'')]
